I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  in  (8 bits)
 - output out (4 bits)

The module should count the number of bits in the input vector that are
1, also known as a population count. The output is a value from 0 to 8.

This is purely combinational logic. There is no clock and no reset.

Solve only the public RTL specification supplied by the user. Use check_rtl with a complete SystemVerilog module to check each proposed candidate. The tool checks interface, syntax and DUT-only synthesis, not functional correctness. Fix reported errors within the request budget. Then finish with a short summary; the last checked candidate is the output. No shell, filesystem, hidden tests, reference designs or previous answers are available. Do not use file directives, strings, escaped identifiers, system tasks, foreign code or markdown in source. Respect widths, reset polarity, initial-state requirements and cycle timing. Do not claim VERIFIED or hidden-test success.
